description: The HYPERGRYD final project report describes coupled thermal-electric simulations and digital twins for the SONNE and ENVIPARK laboratories. It links BIM-GIS preparation, the SAInt solver and an exergo-economic optimiser. The provider is HYPERGRYD consortium, published through CORDIS. Coverage: The project ran from October 2021 to March 2025; the final reporting period is April 2024–March 2025. Site-specific model resolution is not established on the summary page. Access: The provider’s public abstract, report page or official summary was read. No underlying event data or executable reconstruction was obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Completion, validation and energy savings are consortium-reported results. This review did not read Deliverable 5.3 or verify access to the digital-twin models. For simulation it documents a district-energy coupling and demonstration application. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this named application or event analysis.
